description.value: Mario's Coffee Express Ltd is a café located in the heart of downtown Vancouver on Howe Street, occupying a ground-floor unit well-positioned for weekday foot traffic. The 'Express' branding suggests a quick-service counter format oriented toward the downtown office crowd. Cyclists passing through the financial district core would find it a convenient stop for a coffee fix on weekdays.
